description: Real-build dogfood plan for the Rust substrate preview. Entries are deliberately higher-level than the unit corpus: they group realistic Gradle build shapes that should feel meaningful in the first minute of use.

projects.name: oss-style-java-library

source.description: Checked-in OSS-style Java library fixture with sources JAR, Javadoc, reports, and standard lifecycle tasks.

projects.reason: Represents the simplest externally showable Java library shape: compile, resources, jar, sources, javadoc, tests/report-like outputs.

projects.name: java-multiproject
projects.reason: Exercises project dependency wiring and selected DAG materialization across multiple projects.

projects.name: external-junit-library

source.description: Checked-in project using pinned JUnit Platform dependencies from Maven Central or a warm Gradle cache.

projects.reason: Visible dependency resolution plus real JUnit Platform test execution is a first-minute credibility gate.

projects.name: external-bom-and-conflict

source.description: Checked-in external dependency project with a Maven BOM/platform-managed graph.

projects.reason: Proves a bounded but important Rust-owned dependency solver slice beyond direct static coordinates.

projects.name: unsupported-composite-substitution

source.description: Checked-in unsupported fixture with explicit settings-level includeBuild substitution semantics.

projects.reason: Demonstrates that the preview rejects unsupported composite substitution at admission instead of approximating included-build semantics.
